name: byspace-relay-go
description: The BySpace relay, compiled to WebAssembly and hosted on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && npm run build && wrangler deploy
scripts.build:web: npm --prefix ../.. run build:app-deps && npm --prefix ../../web run build
scripts.deploy:beta: npm run build:web && npm run build && wrangler deploy --env beta
